invariant: Propose, but never execute, a split of one named Java package only after the JDK compiler attributes all eligible source and resolves caller imports/FQCN type references.

native_model.build_boundary: standalone source set; no Maven, Gradle, annotation processors, module path, or third-party JARs

outcomes.complete_refactor: two or more leading type-name domains each contain at least two top-level types and compiler-resolved caller impact is available
outcomes.complete_defer: one cohesive domain does not justify a boundary
outcomes.unsupported: old/missing JDK, excluded/symlink/default/mixed package, or unsupported target topology
outcomes.failed_or_partial: malformed or unresolved compilation never becomes a clean proposal

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: JDK compiler bootstrap, path safety, and JSON emission
reuse_decision.actual_second_consumer: move-path has a different transactional and exact-span contract
reuse_decision.decision: keep the semantic analyzers family-local for J1; revisit only the repeated launcher/plumbing after measuring maintenance cost
reuse_decision.reason: sharing compiler outputs would couple a read-only proposal to a mutation safety boundary

product_cost: The self-contained Java runner is 677 lines after closeout regressions. This is acceptable for a bounded pilot but is a simplification/backlog signal, not a template to multiply unchanged across 22 skills.
next_language_guidance: Use the host-native compiler for only the final facts the skill claims; prove a cohesive defer and resolved-caller positive before broadening to frameworks.
